posts.title: Afternoon Sunwatch
posts.text:
☀️ Afternoon Sunwatch — September 12, 2026

🔆️ Solar activity: Low (B4.9)
🔥 Latest solar flare: B8.3 (Peaked September 12, 2026 at 18:30 UTC)
🔥 Strongest recent flare: C5.8 (Peaked September 12, 2026 at 17:20 UTC)
💨 Solar wind speed: 410 km/s (Moderate)
🌎 Geomagnetic activity: Quiet (Kp 1.33)

Little spark from the Sun! 🔥

Today’s solar images show broad dark coronal-hole regions and several bright active regions, with no clearly visible large outward eruption in the coronagraph.

Image: NOAA GOES-19 SUVI — 131 Å
Data: NOAA Space Weather Prediction Center

posts.text:
